## Session Setup

- Confirm the 2026 pre- and post-session survey links before publishing.
- Confirm site-specific rapid response, code blue, shock team, cath lab, brain attack, and VA transfer workflows.
- Confirm the Zoll model and defibrillator workflow learners will practice.
- Keep public slides learner-safe; put facilitator-only answers, prompts, and timing notes in the instructor guide.

## What To Update After Each Cohort

- Survey links and QR codes.
- Manual PDF and quick-reference screenshots.
- Case order, scenario wording, and any site-specific changes.
- References that materially affect resuscitation leadership, termination, family presence, or rapid response systems.
- README, `CITATION.cff`, and release/archive notes.
